# routing redline and operation state

Case: CASE-067
Document control number: SPEC-0067
Effective revision: R5
Superseded revision visible in archive: R9
Subject: routing inspection step
Primary measure: open operations affected by the routing revision
Source finished or header quantity: 60
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 OPERATIONS
Unit: OPERATIONS
Eligibility definition: operation inside effectivity and not yet started
Exclusion definition: completed or out-of-effectivity operations
Control: routing sequence, predecessor, workcenter qualification, and open state

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000067, organization SEA, and CASE-067. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from revised routing window; external timing is conditional on inspection fixture readiness. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
